title: Malpura
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: In frying pan,add sugar and water,mix well and cook until sugar is dissolved.
steps.romanUrdu: Frying pan mein cheeni aur pani dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur cheeni ghul janay tak paka lein.

steps.instruction: Add cardamom powder,lemon juice,mix well & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Elaichi powder aur lemon juice dal ker ache tarhan mix karein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In bowl,add lukewarm milk,sugar and whisk well.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein neem garam pani aur cheeni dal ker ache tarhan whisk ker lein.
Sooji dal ker dubara whisk ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add cardamom powder,gradually add all-purpose flour and whisk until well combined.
steps.romanUrdu: Elaichi powder aur thora thora ker ka maida shamil kertay jayein aur ache tarhan whisk ker lein.
Anday dal ker dubara whisk karein.

steps.instruction: Gradually add lukewarm milk and whisk until smooth batter is formed.
steps.romanUrdu: Thora thora ker ka neem garam doodh shamil karein aur smooth batter bannay tak ache tarhan whisk ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add yellow food color and whisk well,cover and rest it for 1 hour.
steps.romanUrdu: Yellow food color dal ker ache tarhan whisk karein aur dhak ker 1 hour kliya rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Add baking soda and whisk again.
steps.romanUrdu: Baking soda dal ker dubara whisk ker lein.

steps.instruction: In frying pan,add cooking oil and pour prepared batter (approx. ½ cup) and fry from both sides until golden brown.
steps.romanUrdu: Frying pan mein cooking oil aur tayyar batter (approx. ½ cup) dal dein aur dono sides sa golden brown hunay tak fry ker lein.

steps.instruction: In sugar syrup,add prepared malpuras and soak for 10 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Sheeray mein tayyar malpuras dal ker 10 minutes kliya chor dein.

steps.instruction: Garnish with cream,almonds and pistachios & serve!
steps.romanUrdu: Cream aur badam & pista sa garnish ker ka serve karein.

ogDescription: So many Malpura recipes out there but here is a reliable one from Food Fusion give it a try. #HappyCookingToYou
